fun_facts: Quinnen Williams is from Birmingham, Alabama, and attended Wenonah High School.
He came to Alabama as a defensive end and added weight to play on the inside of the defensive line.
In 2018, he recorded 71 tackles, 19.5 tackles for loss and 8 sacks, and won the Outland Trophy.
Quinnen Williams was a unanimous first-team All-American in 2018.
At the NFL Scouting Combine, he ran the 40-yard dash in 4.83 seconds—then the fourth-fastest time by a 300-plus-pound defensive lineman there since 2003.
